relationships.name: Failure
relationships.description: Request FlowFiles transferred when receiving socket communication errors.

relationships.name: No Retry
relationships.description: Request FlowFiles transferred when receiving HTTP responses with a status code between 400 an 499.

relationships.name: Original
relationships.description: Request FlowFiles transferred when receiving HTTP responses with a status code between 200 and 299.

relationships.name: Response
relationships.description:
Response FlowFiles transferred when receiving HTTP responses with a status code between 200 and 299.
Enabling [Response Generation Required] changes routing behavior, sending unsuccessful responses to their corresponding relationships
and also sending FlowFiles to the Response relationship as well, regardless of status code received.

relationships.name: Retry
relationships.description: Request FlowFiles transferred when receiving HTTP responses with a status code between 500 and 599.

HTTP Method.name: HTTP Method
HTTP Method.description: HTTP request method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS). Arbitrary methods are also supported. Methods other than POST, PUT and PATCH will be sent without a message body.

HTTP URL.name: HTTP URL
HTTP URL.description: HTTP remote URL including a scheme of http or https, as well as a hostname or IP address with optional port and path elements. Any encoding of the URL must be done by the user.

HTTP/2 Disabled.name: HTTP/2 Disabled
HTTP/2 Disabled.description: Disable negotiation of HTTP/2 protocol. HTTP/2 requires TLS. HTTP/1.1 protocol supported is required when HTTP/2 is disabled.

SSL Context Service.name: SSL Context Service
SSL Context Service.description: SSL Context Service provides trusted certificates and client certificates for TLS communication.

Connection Timeout.name: Connection Timeout
Connection Timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for initial socket connection to the HTTP URL.

Socket Read Timeout.name: Socket Read Timeout
Socket Read Timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for receiving responses from a socket connection to the HTTP URL.

Socket Write Timeout.name: Socket Write Timeout
Socket Write Timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for write operations while sending requests from a socket connection to the HTTP URL.

Socket Idle Timeout.name: Socket Idle Timeout
Socket Idle Timeout.description: Maximum time to wait before closing idle connections to the HTTP URL.

Socket Idle Connections.name: Socket Idle Connections
Socket Idle Connections.description: Maximum number of idle connections to the HTTP URL.

Proxy Configuration Service.name: Proxy Configuration Service
Proxy Configuration Service.description: Specifies the Proxy Configuration Controller Service to proxy network requests. In case of SOCKS, it is not guaranteed that the selected SOCKS Version will be used by the processor.

Request OAuth2 Access Token Provider.name: Request OAuth2 Access Token Provider
Request OAuth2 Access Token Provider.description: Enables managed retrieval of OAuth2 Bearer Token applied to HTTP requests using the Authorization Header.

OAuth2 Access Token Refresh Strategy.name: OAuth2 Access Token Refresh Strategy
OAuth2 Access Token Refresh Strategy.description: Specifies which strategy should be used to refresh the OAuth2 Access Token.

allowableValue.description: The token will be refreshed based on its expiration time and the configured refresh window
A new token will be requested in case of a non-authorized request (HTTP 401) even if the current token has not expired

Request Username.name: Request Username
Request Username.description: The username provided for authentication of HTTP requests. Encoded using Base64 for HTTP Basic Authentication as described in RFC 7617.

Request Password.name: Request Password
Request Password.description: The password provided for authentication of HTTP requests. Encoded using Base64 for HTTP Basic Authentication as described in RFC 7617.

Request Digest Authentication Enabled.name: Request Digest Authentication Enabled
Request Digest Authentication Enabled.description: Enable Digest Authentication on HTTP requests with Username and Password credentials as described in RFC 7616.

Request Failure Penalization Enabled.name: Request Failure Penalization Enabled
Request Failure Penalization Enabled.description: Enable penalization of request FlowFiles when receiving HTTP response with a status code between 400 and 499.

Request Body Enabled.name: Request Body Enabled
Request Body Enabled.description: Enable sending HTTP request body for PATCH, POST, or PUT methods.

Request Multipart Form-Data Name.name: Request Multipart Form-Data Name
Request Multipart Form-Data Name.description: Enable sending HTTP request body formatted using multipart/form-data and using the form name configured.

Request Multipart Form-Data Filename Ena.name: Request Multipart Form-Data Filename Enabled
Request Multipart Form-Data Filename Ena.description: Enable sending the FlowFile filename attribute as the filename parameter in the Content-Disposition Header for multipart/form-data HTTP requests.

Request Chunked Transfer-Encoding Enable.name: Request Chunked Transfer-Encoding Enabled
Request Chunked Transfer-Encoding Enable.description: Enable sending HTTP requests with the Transfer-Encoding Header set to chunked, and disable sending the Content-Length Header. Transfer-Encoding applies to the body in HTTP/1.1 requests as described in RFC 7230 Section 3.3.1

Request Content-Encoding.name: Request Content-Encoding
Request Content-Encoding.description: HTTP Content-Encoding applied to request body during transmission. The receiving server must support the selected encoding to avoid request failures.

allowableValue.description: Content encoding not applied during transmission
Gzip content encoding and HTTP Content-Encoding header applied during transmission

Request Content-Type.name: Request Content-Type
Request Content-Type.description: HTTP Content-Type Header applied to when sending an HTTP request body for PATCH, POST, or PUT methods. The Content-Type defaults to application/octet-stream when not configured.

Request Date Header Enabled.name: Request Date Header Enabled
Request Date Header Enabled.description: Enable sending HTTP Date Header on HTTP requests as described in RFC 7231 Section 7.1.1.2.

Request Header Attributes Pattern.name: Request Header Attributes Pattern
Request Header Attributes Pattern.description: Regular expression that defines which FlowFile attributes to send as HTTP headers in the request. If not defined, no attributes are sent as headers. Dynamic properties will be always be sent as headers. The dynamic property name will be the header key and the dynamic property value, interpreted as Expression Language, will be the header value. Attributes and their values are limited to ASCII characters due to the requirement of the HTTP protocol.

Request User-Agent.name: Request User-Agent
Request User-Agent.description: HTTP User-Agent Header applied to requests. RFC 7231 Section 5.5.3 describes recommend formatting.

Response Body Attribute Name.name: Response Body Attribute Name
Response Body Attribute Name.description: FlowFile attribute name used to write an HTTP response body for FlowFiles transferred to the Original relationship.

Response Body Attribute Size.name: Response Body Attribute Size
Response Body Attribute Size.description: Maximum size in bytes applied when writing an HTTP response body to a FlowFile attribute. Attributes exceeding the maximum will be truncated.

Response Body Ignored.name: Response Body Ignored
Response Body Ignored.description: Disable writing HTTP response FlowFiles to Response relationship

Response Cache Enabled.name: Response Cache Enabled
Response Cache Enabled.description: Enable HTTP response caching described in RFC 7234. Caching responses considers ETag and other headers.

Response Cache Size.name: Response Cache Size
Response Cache Size.description: Maximum size of HTTP response cache in bytes. Caching responses considers ETag and other headers.

Response Cookie Strategy.name: Response Cookie Strategy
Response Cookie Strategy.description: Strategy for accepting and persisting HTTP cookies. Accepting cookies enables persistence across multiple requests.

Response Generation Required.name: Response Generation Required
Response Generation Required.description: Enable generation and transfer of a FlowFile to the Response relationship regardless of HTTP response status code received.

Response FlowFile Naming Strategy.name: Response FlowFile Naming Strategy
Response FlowFile Naming Strategy.description: Determines the strategy used for setting the filename attribute of FlowFiles transferred to the Response relationship.

allowableValue.description: FlowFile filename attribute will be a random value.
FlowFile filename attribute will be extracted from the remote URL path. The attribute may contain URL encoded characters. If the path doesn't exist, the attribute will be a random value.

Response Header Request Attributes Enabl.name: Response Header Request Attributes Enabled
Response Header Request Attributes Enabl.description: Enable adding HTTP response headers as attributes to FlowFiles transferred to the Original, Retry or No Retry relationships.

Response Header Request Attributes Prefi.name: Response Header Request Attributes Prefix
Response Header Request Attributes Prefi.description: Prefix to HTTP response headers when included as attributes to FlowFiles transferred to the Original, Retry or No Retry relationships.  It is recommended to end with a separator character like '.' or '-'.

Response Redirects Enabled.name: Response Redirects Enabled
Response Redirects Enabled.description: Enable following HTTP redirects sent with HTTP 300 series responses as described in RFC 7231 Section 6.4.
